verdict.rationale: An HR/payroll SaaS like Justworks could plausibly publish an interactive API reference, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only help-center articles about payroll, benefits, time off and the Xero integration, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs and llms.txt all returned 404. Nothing documents an API reference or runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
